flows.name: Discover and vet a role/topic resource set
steps: Resolve an active training role and topic
Search public YouTube training through the shared Tavily helper
Canonicalize URLs and apply free-only, non-Procore, and depth gates
Compare canonical URLs with the live resource library
flows.expectedOutcome: Only new resources with positive free and depth evidence remain eligible; every rejection names its reason.

flows.name: Create a human review candidate
steps: Run the finder with explicit commit and a one-candidate insert limit
Execute the existing atomic create_training_review_candidate RPC
Read back the resource, topic, and role link
flows.expectedOutcome: The row is free, status review, linked to the requested active taxonomy, and remains unpublished.

checks: Not applicable: ALL-22 has no rendered frontend surface.
Operator JSON output contains explicit counts and per-result decisions.

claims.description: Untrusted provider results cannot bypass free-only, Procore, depth, canonical URL, or duplicate gates.
Accepted results write only through the atomic candidate RPC and are read back as free review rows.
Required Render provider/database variables exist and failures are explicit.
An independent reviewer approves the provider, dedupe, and RPC boundaries.
